draft_en.subject: PoE switches for your Errichter partners - neutral line, distributor pricing
draft_en.body:
Hello Mr. Hövelmann,

Saga Telecom supplies PoE and L2+ switches to security and network distributors in Europe - under our label or the distributor's own. For a video-surveillance wholesaler the useful addition is usually a neutral PoE line that the installer can put under any camera brand without a price discussion.

Reference points at distributor level: STC-2224GP (24 x GE PoE+ + 2 x GE + 2 x SFP, 300 W, unmanaged) USD 86; 8-port PoE+ units from USD 28; STC-4424GCPM (24 x GE PoE+ + 4 x GE + 4 x SFP, L2 managed, 300 W) USD 165, all EXW Shenzhen, snapshot 2026-10-27, valid 15 days, CE/RoHS/REACH, 12-month warranty. Watchdog/PoE-reset and 250 m extend mode on the unmanaged units, VLAN/QoS/ERPS on the managed.

Would you like the PoE price sheet, or shall I start with a paid sample of the 24-port for your technicians?

Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com

notes: 不点名 Dahua PoE 比价。
